description: Block a story on a specific PERSON's answer — a first-class human blocker (not a title-prefix hack). Attaches an open clarification { question, audience } to the story; the audience must be a member of this workspace. Emits a story.input_requested audit event (attributed: agent identity + the authorizing user). Use this when you need a human decision/answer to proceed — the person is notified with the question + a deep link (INDTEK-497) and the card shows a 'Waiting on <person>' badge (INDTEK-498). Answering does NOT auto-move the lane.

audienceEmail.description: Email of the person to ask. Must be a member of this workspace. Provide this OR audienceUid (at least one).

audienceUid.description: UID of the person to ask. Must be a member of this workspace. Provide this OR audienceEmail (at least one).

question.description: What you need answered, in plain language. Shown to the person on the card and (INDTEK-497) in their notification.

storyId.description: UUID of the story to attach the clarification to.

name: request_input
